name: valve_citadel_diggers
note: HL2 d3_citadel_01's three diggers, the Citadel's pistons pounding the ground under it (train_digger1 to 3: func_tracktrain of citadel metal 192 x 192 x 2112, a block 1280 tall on a rod 64 x 56 x 832; each on two path_tracks 384 apart: it drops at its full speed (startspeed 500 or 600), Stops on the bottom track with a shake, a hit sound and dust, rises at half speed 2 s later, Stops on the top track for 2 s, and again; a logic_auto starts them 1, 4 and 6 s after the map starts). Anchor: digger 1's foot at the top of its stroke. The two small trains also named train_digger2 and _3 are Valve's gauges on tracks in a control room (they move with the big ones). The housing brushes inside the box come too, as static brushes. Placed by map_core.py (the suppression core under City 18's Nexus).
